parts.name: Root
parts.description: The value, the cells and the focus between them. It renders a div with role="group", named by PinInput.Label.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable id, from which the component makes its internal ARIA ids. Give one on a server.

props.name: value
props.description:
The value. It is never longer than `length`, and it has no holes: the characters fill the
cells from the first one. You can bind it with `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value at the start, for when you give no `value`.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the value. The component stops to write back to `value`,
and it reports only through `onChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it on each change.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: The component calls it one time, when the last cell takes a character.

props.name: length
props.description: The count of cells. The default is 6.

props.name: type
props.description:
Which characters the cells accept: only the digits, the letters, or both. The default is
`numeric`, which also sets the numeric keyboard on a telephone.

props.name: pattern
props.description: A test of your own for one character. It replaces the test of `type`.

props.name: otp
props.description:
Marks the cells as a code from a message. The telephone then offers the code of the last
message above the keyboard, and one touch fills each cell.

props.name: mask
props.description: Hides the characters, as a password field does.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The text of an empty cell.

props.name: blurOnComplete
props.description: Moves the focus off the last cell when the value is complete.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables each cell. The cells leave the tab order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the cells in the tab order, but the value does not change.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the value as necessary. Each cell gets `required`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as invalid. Each cell gets `aria-invalid`.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the hidden input that carries the whole value in a form.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form that the hidden input belongs to, when the group is outside it.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the group, for when there is no `PinInput.Label`.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives the group its name, in place of `PinInput.Label`.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The id of the element that describes the group, for example an error message.

props.name: children
props.description: The content: the label and the cells.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the root element.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable reference to the context, for a composition of your own.

dataAttributes.name: data-complete
dataAttributes.description: Present while each cell has a character.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus in the field must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while a cell has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field is necessary.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: The accessible name of the group. It renders a span, and the root points at it with aria-labelledby. A press on it puts the focus on the first cell that is open.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the label.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field is disabled.

parts.name: Cell
parts.description: One character of the value. It renders a native input of one character, with its own name, its inputmode and its autocomplete.

props.name: index
props.description: The index of the cell. Without it, the cells take the indexes in mount order.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The name of this cell, for the screen reader. The default is "Digit 2 of 6".

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the cell.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-active
dataAttributes.description: Present on the cell that takes the next character.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has a character.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus on the cell must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-index
dataAttributes.description: The index of the cell, from 0.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field is read-only.
